statements.status_notes: The DataInput-backed UTF8DataInputJsonParser can accumulate an unbounded malformed-token error string because it omits the error-token length limit enforced by other parser implementations. This can exhaust resources. Whether applications create parsers from untrusted DataInput sources remains unverified. Upstream fixes the relevant 2.21 line in 2.21.7. The observed bundled Jackson component has base version 2.21.5. Open Liberty 26.0.0.11 ships this code inside vendor-assembled bundles. Changing a standalone library dependency does not replace that bundled implementation; a compatible vendor release or validated bundle remediation and application-specific applicability assessment remain unresolved. A base-version scanner match alone does not establish exploitability. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-7hhh-6rmp-j9qf.

jackson-core 2.22.2 is bytecode-shaded inside parquet-hadoop-bundle 1.18.1 (latest on Maven Central). Gradle resolutionStrategy cannot relocate shaded classes; swapping class files without a shade step breaks linkage. Fixing requires an upstream parquet-hadoop-bundle release that embeds jackson-core 2.22.3 or later.

Neo4j Maven jackson.version property bumps standalone jackson-core artifacts to 2.22.3. The only remaining 2.22.2 copy is shaded inside parquet-jackson 1.18.1, which has no newer parquet release. CVE-2026-89407 is triggered when jackson-databind coerces attacker-supplied string tokens to numbers via NumberInput.looksLikeValidNumber(); parquet-jackson deserializes only its own fixed-schema footer metadata POJOs from on-disk Parquet files and does not run that coercion on untrusted HTTP JSON payloads, so the ReDoS path is not reachable through Neo4j's usage.

Neo4j Maven jackson.version property bumps standalone jackson-core artifacts to 2.22.3. The only remaining 2.22.2 copy is shaded inside parquet-jackson 1.18.1, which has no newer parquet release. CVE-2026-89425 is reachable only through JsonFactory.createParser(DataInput) on attacker-controlled input; parquet-jackson reads Parquet footers with stream-based parsers and does not expose a DataInput parser surface on Neo4j's Parquet import path, so the unbounded invalid-token accumulation path is not reachable.
